highlights: Strong safeguarding culture and child protection framework
Use of CPOMS as a separate Safeguarding platform
Air-conditioned buses with seat belts and GPS tracking
safety.policy_summary: Traill International School maintains a comprehensive Child Protection and Safeguarding Policy modeled on international best practices and regulations from Thailand and the UK. The school employs digital record-keeping via CPOMS, promotes healthy lifestyle initiatives including air purifiers, and enforces strict codes of conduct and visitor protocols to ensure a secure environment.
